copy.curiosityHook: As the cockpit becomes a high-stakes standoff, the co-pilot begins to forge an unexpected connection with one of the hijackers.
copy.description: On a flight from Berlin to Paris, terrorists attempt to seize the aircraft, leaving a soft-spoken American co-pilot fighting to protect the passengers and crew under extreme pressure.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-moving, immersive, and relentlessly tense, delivering compact suspense ideal for focused solo viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Director Patrick Vollrath crafts an intensely focused in-flight thriller that transforms an urgent airborne crisis into a compact, human-scale battle of nerves.
